description: The customer wants to transfer ownership of their account to another person / have another person take over the account in their stead. This could be due to selling a device, gifting a line to a family member, or separating a joint account. They need assistance with the process of changing the account holder's name and billing responsibility, ensuring a smooth transition of service to the new owner.
